sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pumpkin with sweets (Pumpkin) is a pickupable Event Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Looks like someone in Tarkov decided to have some fun and scattered these pumpkins all over the place. There could definitely be something inside them.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text: | Pumpkin with sweets x1; Pumpkin with sweets | → | Cultist Circle; Unique Sacrifice; 1 h 6 min | → | Jack-o'-lantern tactical pumpkin helmet x1; Jack-o'-lantern tactical pumpkin helmet |

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - This item was first added as part of Escape from Tarkov's 2022 Halloween celebration.
